dbl.text: Chishiro, a samurai once bonded to the kami Kaima, is long past that bond, which broke years ago when a boy poisoned his order and demanded Kaima bond with him, so that Chishiro let Kaima go, the blade shattered and he went on to become a sellsword.
In Far Corner he trains the townsfolk and plans a trap with disruptors to drive the Mukotai toward Jukai, and he recognizes Tatsunari as the man who betrayed him.
Tatsunari stabs him through the gut at the shrine, but the shrine's kami awakens, healing him and attacking the Mukotai, and Chishiro realizes the kami is Kaima, who intends to destroy everyone.
Chishiro confronts Kaima, and the two realize their rage has poisoned each other and stand down, and when he offers peace and Kaima asks him to bond again, he raises the blade and a light is reborn.
